blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Cebuano standout Nic Cabanero continued to make his case for the SportsPlus MPBL 2026 ‘Most Valuable Player’ award, coming up big when Binan Tatak Gel needed him most in the playoffs. The league’s MVP frontrunner delivered 23 points, nine rebounds, four steals and three assists as Binan turned back Mindoro, 78-70, on Friday at the Caloocan Sports Complex on Saturday, October 3, to take the opening game of their South Division quarterfinal series. Cabanero from Lapu-Lapu City was named the ‘Best Player’ after leading Binan through a game in which the Tamaraws repeatedly threatened to erase their deficit. […]...
